title: Atomic status-based comment pool with modal error handling

requirements.text: Refactor the backend comment pool in `backend/main.mo` to store each comment as a record with a unique `commentId` (Nat), `text` (Text), and `status` (`#available` or `#used`). Replace the existing flat list/count structure with this status-based stable store. Provide a migration that converts all existing pool comments to `#available` status so no data is lost.

quotes: Each comment stored with a unique commentId, text, and status (available → used)
Existing pool data preserved and migrated to the new status-based structure

acceptanceCriteria: Each comment in the pool has a unique commentId (Nat), text (Text), and status (#available | #used).
All previously stored comments are migrated to #available status on upgrade.
The stable store compiles without errors.

requirements.text: Rewrite the `generateSingle` function in `backend/main.mo` so it atomically selects the first `#available` comment, immediately sets its status to `#used` in the same synchronous operation, and returns `#ok(text)`. If no `#available` comment exists, return `#err("Pool is empty")`. No two concurrent calls may receive the same `commentId`.

quotes: generateSingle: atomically selects 1 available comment, marks it used, returns it — or returns an error if pool is empty
Concurrency-safe: two simultaneous requests can never receive the same commentId

acceptanceCriteria: generateSingle returns #ok(text) and marks exactly one comment #used atomically.
generateSingle returns #err("Pool is empty") when no #available comments exist.
Two simultaneous calls never return the same commentId.

requirements.text: Rewrite the `generateBulk` function in `backend/main.mo` to implement strict all-or-nothing semantics. Count the number of `#available` comments. If the count is >= requested N: atomically mark exactly N comments `#used` and return `#ok([text])` with all N texts. If count < N: return `#err("Only " # Nat.toText(count) # " comments left. Reduce quantity.")` and mark zero comments used. No partial fulfillment.

quotes: generateBulk(n): strict all-or-nothing — if remaining >= N, marks all N as used atomically; if remaining < N, returns error with count remaining
If no: return error 'Only X comments left. Reduce quantity.' with zero dispensed

acceptanceCriteria: generateBulk(n) returns #ok([text]) with exactly n items when n or more available comments exist.
generateBulk(n) returns #err("Only X comments left. Reduce quantity.") when fewer than n available comments exist.
On error, zero comments are marked used.
All N comments are marked used in a single atomic operation with no possibility of double-dispensing.

requirements.text: Update the `getPoolStats` backend function in `backend/main.mo` to return the count of comments with `status = #available` as the live inventory count, and the total number of comments (regardless of status) as the total pool size.

quotes: Inventory display: After each generation, update 'Comments left: X' from backend.

acceptanceCriteria: getPoolStats returns { available: Nat; total: Nat } where available reflects only #available comments.
available count decreases by 1 after a successful generateSingle call.
available count decreases by N after a successful generateBulk(N) call.
available count is unchanged after a failed generateBulk call.

requirements.text: Update `SingleGeneratorView.tsx` to display a modal popup (with an OK button to dismiss) when `generateSingle` returns an `#err` variant. The modal must show the error message text. After a successful generation, immediately refetch pool stats so the displayed 'Comments left: X' count is accurate.

quotes: Modal popup (with OK button) for all 'no comments' and 'not enough comments' errors on both Single and Bulk generators
'Comments left: X' refreshed immediately after every generate action

acceptanceCriteria: A modal with an OK button appears when generateSingle returns an error.
The modal displays the exact error message string from the backend.
Clicking OK dismisses the modal.
The 'Comments left' count updates immediately after a successful generate.
No blank/silent failure state is shown to the user.

requirements.text: Update `BulkGeneratorView.tsx` to display a modal popup (with an OK button to dismiss) when `generateBulk` returns an `#err` variant. The modal must show the error message (e.g., 'Only X comments left. Reduce quantity.'). Remove all partial fulfillment UI messaging. After any generate attempt (success or error), immediately invalidate or refetch the pool stats query so 'Comments left: X' is accurate.

quotes: Modal popup (with OK button) for all 'no comments' and 'not enough comments' errors on both Single and Bulk generators
'Comments left: X' refreshed immediately after every generate action

acceptanceCriteria: A modal with an OK button appears when generateBulk returns an error.
The modal shows the backend error message text.
Clicking OK dismisses the modal.
No partial fulfillment message or 'X of Y dispensed' text is shown.
The 'Comments left' count updates immediately after every generate attempt.

constraints: All Motoko logic must remain in backend/main.mo (single-actor architecture).
Existing pool comment text data must be preserved through migration — no comments may be silently dropped.
Do not modify any file under frontend/src/hooks/ that is listed as immutable (useInternetIdentity.ts, useActor.ts) or frontend/src/main.tsx or frontend/src/components/ui.
generateBulk must be strictly all-or-nothing — no partial fulfillment is allowed.
nonGoals: Partial fulfillment mode for bulk generation.
Per-user or per-device comment reservation (reservedBy/reservedAt fields).
Changes to any admin panel features beyond pool stats reflecting the new available count.
Any other backend function changes not directly related to the comment pool.
